updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Permissions Audit Log Improvements
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview now provides enhanced audit logs with clearer visibility into role and scoped-role access decisions, helping administrators troubleshoot access issues and monitor authorization outcomes. This improvement makes it easier for admins to track who accessed the Purview portal and why access was granted or denied.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: View-Only Device Management Role for Endpoint DLP
updates.summary: A new View-Only Device Management role provides least-privilege access to the Devices page under Endpoint DLP Settings, allowing auditors and security analysts to view device onboarding status without requiring broad administrative roles. This reduces excessive permissions and improves security posture through granular, scoped RBAC.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Labeling Scale Increase for SharePoint and OneDrive
updates.summary: Microsoft is increasing the maximum auto-labeling capacity from 100,000 to 500,000 files per tenant per day for SharePoint and OneDrive, enabling organizations to label and protect more data at rest faster. This enhancement helps close labeling gaps and prepares data estates for Microsoft 365 Copilot with greater coverage.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Labeling Per-Policy Coverage Report
updates.summary: Admins can now view per-policy coverage reports showing how many files have been labeled or remain unlabeled, and whether files were included in the last simulation snapshot. This visibility helps administrators understand enforcement progress for specific policies and identify labeling gaps.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Auto-Labeling Scalability, Policy Management, and Reporting Enhancements
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview is expanding auto-labeling support for larger SharePoint scopes, improving policy management flexibility, and providing richer visibility into auto-labeling activity. These enhancements enable organizations to manage and validate labeling policies at enterprise scale.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Guided Diagnostics Experience
updates.summary: A new guided diagnostics experience helps users understand why DLP policies may not behave as expected, showing which policies were triggered, evaluation order, and condition details. E5 customers also receive Copilot-powered insights and recommendations to accelerate troubleshooting and policy optimization.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DSPM Copilot Readiness and Data Explorer
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview Data Security Posture Management now includes readiness assessments for Microsoft Copilot and a data explorer, providing visibility into sensitive data exposure, oversharing, and protection coverage. These capabilities help security teams assess and prioritize remediation of data risks.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP Policy Sync and Device Health AI-Powered Investigation
updates.summary: AI-powered visibility into Endpoint DLP policy deployment across devices helps administrators track sync progress and enforcement coverage, proactively identifying impacted devices and explaining root causes of sync failures. This capability accelerates diagnosis and resolution of policy deployment issues.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management Archive Expansion Beyond 1.5TB
updates.summary: Archive mailboxes can now automatically expand beyond the previously hard 1.5 TB limit, ensuring uninterrupted retention and scalable archive growth. This enhancement is available to customers with eligible E5 licenses and prevents mailboxes from becoming inoperative due to storage limits.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP FTP and SFTP Monitoring
updates.summary: Endpoint DLP now provides general availability for monitoring sensitive data transferred over FTP and SFTP protocols with the ability to apply restrictive actions based on organizational policy. Administrators can configure FTP and SFTP transfer activities in Endpoint DLP policies to protect data in transit.

updates.title: CVE-2026-109460: Microsoft Entra Private Network Connector Information Disclosure
updates.summary: An information disclosure vulnerability in Microsoft Entra Private Network Connector allows an authorized attacker to expose sensitive information locally. Admins should apply security updates to protect connector deployments from unauthorized data exposure.

updates.title: CVE-2026-105590: Windows Active Directory Certificate Services Security Feature Bypass
updates.summary: Improper certificate validation in Windows Active Directory Certificate Services allows an authorized attacker to bypass a security feature over a network. This vulnerability affects identity and certificate-based authentication, and admins should apply updates immediately.

updates.title: CVE-2026-121680: Windows NTLM Spoofing Vulnerability
updates.summary: A spoofing vulnerability in Windows NTLM authentication affects Microsoft Office and other supported products. Organizations should update affected Microsoft Office versions to prevent NTLM-based spoofing attacks that could compromise authentication.

updates.title: CVE-2026-109467: Azure DevOps Server Remote Code Execution
updates.summary: Improper authentication in Azure DevOps Server allows an authorized attacker to execute code remotely over a network. Organizations using Azure DevOps Server should apply security updates to prevent unauthorized code execution.

updates.title: CVE-2026-62903: Microsoft.Data.SqlClient Authentication Bypass
updates.summary: An authentication bypass vulnerability in Microsoft.Data.SqlClient via capture-replay attack allows unauthorized attackers to disclose sensitive information over a network. Administrators should update the SQL client library to prevent credential-based data theft.

updates.title: CVE-2026-109455: Microsoft Office SharePoint Incorrect Authorization
updates.summary: Incorrect authorization in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows an authorized attacker to disclose information over a network. Administrators should apply updates to prevent unauthorized data access through SharePoint.
